injuries.no: James (back injury management) won't be available for Saturday's game against the Rockets, according to Kris Rhim of ESPN.
Embiid has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Rockets due to right foot plantar fasciitis management, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports.

Brown (hamstring) underwent an MRI that showed no signs of a new injury or re-aggravation, but he didn't travel with the team for the road trip, so he will miss the team's next two games, Kris Rhim of ESPN reports.
Wade (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Pacers, Austin Krell of Vertical 76 reports.
Wagner (knee) won't be available for Friday's game against Toronto.
Jakucionis (ankle) won't play Friday's game against the Pistons.
Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
McConnell (hamstring) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the 76ers, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

Haliburton (hamstring) has been ruled out per Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com for Friday's game against the 76ers. The guard participated in practice activities earlier this week as he continues working toward his return.
Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
